about: The Workbench icons of the KronoBattleZone drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/kronobz.png) is the game's own tank sprite (Tanque in kronobz.dat, 25 x 25, on its palette, written by tests/host/test_data) scaled to 125 x 125, MIT like the game. KronoBattleZone-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, KronoBattleZone.info beside the drawer. ReadMe.info is also copied for ReadMe-KronoBattleZone, LICENSE.txt, Controls and Licences.txt; Data.info is the User drawer's icon.
